checks.name: unit completeness: does the gain survive measured CPU time?
checks.detail: producer records and the validator replay agree: DL1 total CPU at c=1.60 vs c=2.00 is 0.95-1.13 per seed at k=21, 22 held-out (medians 1.05/1.02 producer records, 1.07/1.00 replay), i.e. no gain; linear-algebra phase CPU 1.34-1.56x at k=18-22; relations phase 0.58-0.75x at k>=20. Counted mod-ell additions in LA (unpriced in the frozen unit) rise 1.38-1.49x at c=1.60 because the matrix is denser (nnz 1.91-2.03x; k=22 seed 4: 260,289 vs 132,855). In-situ least squares (R2 0.993): 8.0 ns per counted ladd = 1.08 M-eq, 1.5 ns per lmul = 0.21 M-eq. Host is L0 (unisolated): a wall figure is practicality evidence, not a speed claim; counts stand at any level.

findings.text: The 0.655-0.685x (k=21,22) and 0.66-0.78x gains exist only in the frozen N4v2 M-eq unit, which counts but does not price F_q and mod-ell additions. At c=1.60 the matrix is denser (k=22: nnz 260,289 vs 132,855; mean cycle-row weight 68 vs 28), so counted mod-ell additions in LA rise to 1.38-1.49x (nnz 1.9-2.0x). Measured process CPU (producer records and the validator replay): total 0.95-1.13x of c=2.00 per seed at k=21,22 held-out (medians 1.00-1.07, not below 1), LA phase 1.34-1.56x. The order c=1.60<2.00 reverses once an addition is priced above 0.44-0.59 M-eq (the in-situ fit is 1.08 M-eq per ladd) and at the 5a band weights 0.1 and 1 GAE per addition. c=1.75 measures 0.91-0.99x CPU at k=21,22 (medians 0.94-0.97), a smaller gain than its M-eq 0.77. AGENTS.md: a headline count that falls while work moves where the headline does not look is relabelling, not engineering.
RESULTS says the success threshold sits between 1.50 and 1.60 at every k; k=21 and 22 have no data at c<=1.50.
RESULTS: "N4v2 DL1, itself about 0.005x matched negation rho at q=2^21 per its README": the README figure 0.005 is DL; DL1/rho-neg is 0.0028 (summary_supp.json).
RESULTS: "Seeds agree to within 1% at k>=20": true for the c=2.00 cost (0.07-0.40%), not for c=1.60 (cost spread 0.8-4.0%, ratio spread 0.8-3.8%).

J2 PROTOCOL names no rho reference; the rho arm is N4v2 records run in another binary (rustc 1.93.1, M4 Pro) and the k=22 reference is the post-hoc supplement. matches_protocol and same_binary_or_process are false in VALIDATION.json.
The c=2.00 control against the committed N4v2 records is required by the J2 PROTOCOL but RESULTS reports only the A/A repeat; the validator ran it (V3: identical).
Amendment header says 05:00 UTC; its commit is 04:54:39Z, 17 s before the first held-out launch. Order is right, the label is not.
